notes_for_editor: Location, standing status and the cab conflict are sourced; no build date, height, staffing or public-access statement was found. The county survey's Owner column lists Mn MFS for both Maud entries and gives no builder record; its Type column lists the standing tower as Stair. The county survey lists two Maud entries (footings of a first tower, and the standing stair tower) with no dates. Superior Hiking is a hiking blog; its comments are reader reports, not official. A WebSearch hit suggested Grand Portage State Forest near Hovland, but we could not confirm the tower lies inside it, so it is not used. Mount Josephine on Hat Point, also near Grand Portage, is a separate tower the same survey marks removed. An unnamed abandoned tower north of Grand Portage in Minnesota Monthly was not identified with Maud, so it is not used. Access is left unset: no official source says the public may enter. The blog's climbing account is not endorsed; the story says to check with the land manager.
